Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for all activity rows in assay CHEMBL4888485 that have exact measurements (standard_relation '=' and standard_value not null). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join assays on assay_id, and join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to enforce structure availability. Keep every qualifying activity row without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
